rows.target: <sp(20)>What on earth do you mean to do by stealing Shin Dragon's Getter Rays?<ab(1200)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>That is too fine a toy for the likes of you.<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Then I will simply have to stop you.<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>Losing lift!? Balance the Trapar on the left and right!<ab(1200)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>The Tower is under attack.<ab(1200)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>At this rate, the Tower will...!<ab(1200)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>You got in the way of finishing off Saotome!<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Te-form complaint; who was about to finish Saotome is not stated, so no 'my'.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>I saved you, so I'd like a little gratitude, you know.<ab(1000)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>This one... is good.<ab(500)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>So you're Dewey's little brother. Holland, was it?<ab(300)>
<sp(20)>A shame, when you're this skilled...<ab(300)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>You were one of Dewey's people, right? Then I won't hold back.<ab(800)><ed()>
<on()><sp(20)>Ah... L-look, atop Shin Dragon's head... there's a person!<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: 'zujou' can also mean 'overhead/above'; 'atop its head' matches the anime staging.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>It has been a long time, all of you.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Dr. Saotome...<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>So that's... Saotome.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>You... So you were alive.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Nuahahahahaha! I, Saotome, do not die so easily.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>All units, deploy! The target is Shin Dragon!<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Hehehehe, hahahahaha! Haa-hahahaha!<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Come if you dare. The likes of you will not lay a single finger on it.<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: Object omitted in source; 'it' = Shin Dragon, the declared target in 2313.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>Wh-what on earth is this...?<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Shin Dragon's Getter Rays are concentrating on a single point!<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Don't tell me... it has begun? Its evolution...!<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: 'yatsu' read as Shin Dragon (its evolution), per 2318/2320.

<on()><sp(20)>I will protect you.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Who are you?<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Shin Dragon's Getter Ray level is dropping rapidly!<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>It's them!<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Letting you people live was the right choice.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Getter Ray emission dropping even further!<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>The Getter Rays are being absorbed?<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>You two, I shall tell.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>What it... means!?<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>Looks like this will be a little fun after all.<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>Rotten luck...!<ab(500)><off()>

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>Ange, our business is done. We're withdrawing.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>We will meet again, Hayato Jin.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>What are you after?<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Asking your enemy? Did you expect an answer?<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>The Baldora Drive is a thing that can connect spaces far apart from each other.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Somewhere that is not our own world. Yes... to another space that exists in parallel.<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: 'jibun-tachi no sekai' = one's own world; 'our' chosen as the speaker is explaining to allies.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>You do know what will happen once it is fully running, don't you?<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>As a reward, I will tell you. Point A-5-3X.<ab(500)><off()>
rows.notes: Fullwidth point code converted to ASCII.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>I would very much like you all to know despair.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Hold on a second. What are you, anyway!?<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Farewell.<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>H-how do you know my name...?<ab(500)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Captain. We'll reach A-5-3X shortly. We've found a <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>So there was one of those facilities over here too...
<on()><sp(20)>A huge <book(3)>Wormhole<endbook()> has been observed above the facility.
<on()><sp(20)>That's not all. Huge gravity wave surges are growing in step with that energy.
<on()><sp(20)>I knew it...
<on()><sp(20)>What do you mean? Explain it to us.
<on()><sp(20)>We were told the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> forms a <book(3)>Wormhole<endbook()> at two distant points to link the spaces.
<on()><sp(20)>But rather than simply linking distant places, for some reason it became a passage to another world...
<on()><sp(20)>I believe that is the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>'s true function.
<on()><sp(20)>Hard to believe... but given all that has happened so far, it is the most reasonable conclusion, then.
<on()><sp(20)>But going by his words and actions, the <book(3)>Wormhole<endbook()> is not fully open yet.
<on()><sp(20)>The energy we observed... It is still showing signs of rising.
<on()><sp(20)>And along with it, we can see the <book(3)>Wormhole<endbook()> stabilizing as it expands.
<on()><sp(20)>In other words, running the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> seems to take an enormous amount of energy.
<on()><sp(20)>When it reaches critical, I think the link completes and the two worlds become fully connected.
<on()><sp(20)>Perhaps that is why <color(5)>Berkt<ce()> is after the <book(51)>Getter Rays<endbook()>.
<on()><sp(20)>What do <book(51)>Getter Rays<endbook()> have to do with it?
<on()><sp(20)>Those <color(5)>unmanned units<ce()> had a mechanism for securing power, likely used to gather the power the Drive needs.
rows.notes: Two source sentences merged to fit. Review: 'it' had no clear antecedent (read as the mechanism/units); the thing being run is the Baldora Drive (2370, 2376), now named.
